title: 台湾でM6・1地震、北東部・宜蘭県などで震度4観測
extracted_text: 【台北＝西見由章】台湾の気象当局によると、1日午後8時40分（日本時間同9時40分）ごろ、北東部・宜蘭県沖の海域を震源とするマグニチュード（M）6・1の地震があった。震源の深さは98・3キロ。宜蘭県と新竹県、南投県、花蓮県で震度4を観測するなど台湾本島の全土で揺れた。総統府のある台北市は震度2だった。
translated_text: TAIPEI -- According to Taiwan's Central Weather Administration, a magnitude 6.1 earthquake struck in the sea area off Yilan County in northeastern Taiwan at around 8:40 p.m. on the 1st (9:40 p.m. Japan time). The epicenter was at a depth of 98.3 kilometers. Tremors were felt across the entire main island of Taiwan, with Intensity 4 recorded in Yilan, Hsinchu, Nantou, and Hualien counties. The capital Taipei, where the Presidential Office is located, experienced Intensity 2.
title_en: M6.1 Earthquake Hits Taiwan, Intensity 4 Observed in Yilan County and Other Northeastern Areas
